target: doctor.sh forge section — no remote reports that PRs will be recorded as pr: local
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_doctor
grep -q '^forge:' .doctor.out && echo header=yes || echo header=no
fx_sec_has says_local 'pr: local'
fx_sec_has fail '\[FAIL\]'
fx_done
